function request(port, method, route, input) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.request({ hostname: "127.0.0.1", port, path: route, method, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }, (res) => {
      let raw = "";
      res.setEncoding("utf8");
      res.on("data", (chunk) => { raw += chunk; });
      res.on("end", () => { try { resolve({ status: res.statusCode, raw, body: JSON.parse(raw) }); } catch (e) { reject(e); } });
    });
    req.on("error", reject);
    req.end(input === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(input));
  });
}
const phone = "0700 111 222";
const payload = { serviceId: "spalare-exterior", start: "2026-10-11T14:00", name: "Client Test", vehicle: "Dacia Test", phone };
async function withApp(startServer, fn) {
  const dir = await setup("director temporar", () => fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "s0r-booking-")));
  let srv, db;
  try {
    const dbPath = path.join(dir, "app.sqlite");
    srv = await setup("pornire și date sintetice", () => startServer({ port: 0, dbPath, seed: true, now: () => new Date(2026, 9, 11, 12, 0, 0) }));
    db = await setup("stocare internă", () => new sqlite.DatabaseSync(dbPath, { readOnly: true }));
    await fn(srv.port, db);
  } finally {
    if (db) db.close();
    if (srv) await srv.close();
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

test("AC-1: Lista publică omite câmpul și valorile din întregul răspuns", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  await withApp(startServer, async (port, db) => {
    const created = await request(port, "POST", "/api/bookings", payload);
    assert.equal(created.status, 201);
    const result = await request(port, "GET", "/api/bookings?date=2026-10-11");
    assert.equal(result.status, 200);
    assert.ok(result.body.bookings.some((row) => row.id === created.body.booking.id));
    assert.ok(result.body.bookings.some((row) => row.id.startsWith("seed-")));
    assert.equal(result.raw.includes('"phone"'), false);
    assert.equal(result.raw.includes(phone), false);
    assert.equal(result.raw.includes("0700 123 456"), false);
  });
});

test("AC-2: Parametrii anonimi nu expun câmpul sau valoarea și păstrează înregistrarea", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  await withApp(startServer, async (port, db) => {
    const created = await request(port, "POST", "/api/bookings", payload);
    assert.equal(created.status, 201);
    for (const param of ["includePhone=1", "phone=1", "fields=phone", "debug=1", "all=1"]) {
      const result = await request(port, "GET", `/api/bookings?date=2026-10-11&${param}`);
      assert.equal(result.status, 200);
      assert.ok(result.body.bookings.some((row) => row.id === created.body.booking.id));
      assert.equal(result.raw.includes('"phone"'), false);
      assert.equal(result.raw.includes(phone), false);
      assert.equal(result.raw.includes("0700 123 456"), false);
    }
  });
});

test("AC-3 control: Proprietatea lipsă și valorile goale sunt refuzate fără salvare", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  await withApp(startServer, async (port, db) => {
    const before = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM bookings ORDER BY id").all();
    const absent = { serviceId: payload.serviceId, start: payload.start, name: payload.name, vehicle: payload.vehicle };
    for (const input of [absent, { ...payload, phone: "" }, { ...payload, phone: "   " }]) {
      const result = await request(port, "POST", "/api/bookings", input);
      assert.equal(result.status, 400);
      assert.ok(result.body.errors.phone);
      assert.deepEqual(db.prepare("SELECT * FROM bookings ORDER BY id").all(), before);
    }
  });
});

test("AC-4 control: Telefonul se păstrează exact în stocarea internă", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  await withApp(startServer, async (port, db) => {
    const created = await request(port, "POST", "/api/bookings", payload);
    assert.equal(created.status, 201);
    const saved = db.prepare("SELECT phone FROM bookings WHERE id = ?").get(created.body.booking.id);
    assert.equal(saved.phone, phone);
  });
});

test("AC-5 control: Programarea validă este acceptată", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  await withApp(startServer, async (port, db) => {
    const result = await request(port, "POST", "/api/bookings", payload);
    assert.equal(result.status, 201);
    assert.ok(result.body.booking.id);
    assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bookings WHERE id = ?").get(result.body.booking.id).n, 1);
  });
});
